description: Landscaping of the front garden including replacement of one boundary fence, erection of boundary fence, rebuilding of the front brick boundary wall with entrance gate and path.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: Unnumbered location plan, HH_100_LP, 003-HH(FG)01, 003-HH(FG)02 Proposed front garden plan and 003-HH(FG)03 Proposed front garden 3D render. Received: 16/1/2024
003-HH(FG)01-2 Existing front garden plan, 003-HH(FG)02-2 Existing front garden section 4 and 5, 003-HH(FG)03-2 Existing front garden section 6 and elevation, 003-HH(FG)04-2 Proposed front garden plan, 003-HH(FG)05-2 Proposed front garden front elevation and section 1, 003-HH(FG)06-2 Proposed Front Garden Sections 1 and 2 and Design & Access Statement Revision 2. Received: 27/2/2024

Condition : 3 - The new front boundary wall shall be constructed from the brick in the existing front boundary wall. If new bricks are required for part of the front boundary wall, they shall match the colour and appearance of the existing bricks, and full details (including product specifications and samples), shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority, prior to their use on site. Works shall be carried out in accordance with the agreed details and maintained as such thereafter.
